dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Solo is at risk due to behavior concerns. Solo has not acclimated well to the shelter environment, and has shown increasingly defensive behavior escalating from growling and baring teeth at staff when passing by her kennel, or while passing them on leash, to attempting to bite the hand of a staff member when being removed from her kennel. Solo has shown some social behavior with staff outside of these incidents, accepting petting and responding to simple cues. Medically, Solo is apparently healthy.

Solo was surrendered to the care center by her previous owner due to their housing situation. Her previous owner describes Solo as a social, affectionate, quiet dog who enjoys being a lazy couch potato, knows many cues, and loves bones and tennis balls. Solo has not acclimated well to the care center environment and has displayed increasingly defensive behavior while at the care center, growling and baring teeth when staff pass by her kennel, and escalating to attempting to bite the hand of a staff member when removing her from kennel. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide an experience adult-only foster home, allow for decompression and any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
